title: Joint Petition of Cambridge Electric Light Company and Commonwealth Electric Company for pre-approval by the Department of Public Utilities of the Companies' proposed conservation and load management program for a one and one-half year period and for cost recovery for expenses incurred as a result of implementing said program. Such approval is requested pursuant to G.L. c. 164, Section 94 and 220 C.M.R. §§ 9.00 et seq.
